transplantR

Functions for transplant medicine and nephrology, including clinical risk indices, kidney function calculations, and visualization tools.

Features

Clinical Risk Assessment

  • KDRI 2012 - Kidney Donor Risk Index (2012 version)
  • KDRI 2019 - Updated Kidney Donor Risk Index with risk categorization
  • GFR Calculation - CKD-EPI 2021 equation for estimated glomerular filtration rate

Data Processing

  • Cumulative Analysis - Create time-series datasets for transplant activity tracking

Visualization

  • Cumulative Plots - Year-over-year comparison charts with automatic labeling

Installation 

# Install from source
devtools::install_github("Laszlo75/transplantR")

# Or install locally
devtools::install()

Usage

Calculate KDRI scores 

library(transplantR)

# KDRI 2012
kdri_2012 <- calc_kdri2012(
  donor_age_year = 45,
  donor_hypertension = "NO",
  donor_weight = 75,
  donor_days_in_hospital = 2,
  donor_adrenaline = "NO"
)

# KDRI 2019
kdri_2019 <- calc_kdri2019(
  donor_age_year = 55,
  donor_height = 175,
  donor_hypertension = "NO",
  donor_sex = "MALE",
  donor_cmv = "Negative",
  donor_egfr = 85,
  donor_days_in_hospital = 3
)

# Get risk category
calc_kdri2019_category(kdri_2019)

Calculate GFR 

# CKD-EPI 2021 equation
gfr <- calculate_gfr(
  creatinine = 85,  # μmol/L
  age = 50,
  sex = "MALE"
)

Create cumulative visualization 

# Prepare data
cum_df <- create_cumulative_df(
  transplants_df,
  report_year = 2025,
  report_month = 4
)

# Generate plot
plot_cumulative(
  cum_df,
  report_year = 2025,
  report_month = 4
)

Data Privacy

This package provides tools for analyzing transplant data but does NOT include any patient data. Users are responsible for ensuring GDPR and data protection compliance when using this package with real patient data.

Important: Never commit patient data or PDF files containing patient information to version control.
